03The evidence

Research

The evidence. Reports are the research documents, each kept whole and published as it was written. Briefs are short answers to one question, written from those reports, with every quotation checked word for word against the one it comes from. Investigations are the working files on Canadian politics, finance and media: sourced, but open lines of inquiry rather than conclusions.
